code:
GRANT SELECT ON dbo.Employees(EmployeeId, Name, Department) TO HRRole;

GRANT SELECT ON dbo.Employees(EmployeeId, Salary) TO PayrollRole;
caption: Salary simply isn't visible to HRRole — no masking logic needed.
